X.note: This is a clean 3D block-out seen from above, not a low flight along Main Street. Roofs and flat tops dominate the frame. Facades are tiny and low-res with only repeated window grids. Terracotta roof texture is repetitive and the street is a dark blank strip. Lighting is flat and overcast. Textures stay fixed across the four frames.

Y.note: Practically identical to X. The only difference I can see is a slightly cooler, cleaner facade tint on the left buildings. It has the same overhead view, mostly roof, toy-like massing and blank street. Textures stay stable across the frames.

why: The two are nearly indistinguishable, and X is only marginally better because its facade tones are a little warmer and more varied, while Y's are slightly cooler and sterile.
